scope: Finite deterministic development set; NOT statistical acceptance

definitions.primary_float: S03 Float64 MF/MTI/FFT on the original pre-IQ-quantization samples, scaled by 1/8
definitions.isolated_FFT_float: NumPy FFT on identical frozen fixed MTI input codes divided by 32768; scaled by 1/8
definitions.auxiliary_float: S03 Float64 full chain on the same quantized ADC IQ, isolating ADC quantization effects
definitions.complex_RMSE: sqrt(mean(abs(Y-Y_float)^2)); normalized signal units, NOT LSB
definitions.NRMSE_percent: 100*RMSE/sqrt(mean(abs(Y_float)^2)); null if reference energy is zero
definitions.truth_gate: Existing S03 scorer: ±2 range bins, ±1 Doppler bin; development association, not final acceptance
definitions.fixed_power: Exact C05 U46.30 squared magnitude and saturation for both fixed FFT variants
definitions.missing_contract: IP overflow wraps and does not provide C02 prelimit traces; nonoverflow cases only in this corpus
